promptOnDeleteOriginalDesc: Whether to prompt to put the original file into the recycle bin after renaming or saving modified files
enableLoggingDesc: Whether to print plugin running logs in the console
deduplicateDesc: Identify duplicate & visually similar assets, compare and normalize into unique assets
openInTabDesc: When enabled, opens the Assets Manager in a tab instead of a dialog
imageEditorToolsDesc: Control tools displayed in the image editor toolbar (mask and filter are disabled by default)
deletionHistoryLimitDesc: Maximum number of recent deletion operation batches to retain (0-100, default 10; 0 disables history logging)
openRecycleBinDesc: Open OS Recycle Bin window to search and restore files
